subject: general
question: A shopkeeper purchased wheat at Rs. 20 per kg and rice at Rs. 80 per kg. He sold 80 kg of wheat at Rs. 22 per kg and 20 kg of wheat at Rs. 21 per kg. Furthermore, he sold 40 kg of rice at Rs. 95 per kg and 60 kg of rice at Rs. 93 per kg. Find his total profit in this deal.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of wheat = Rs. 20 per kg

Cost price of rice = Rs. 80 per kg

Selling price of 80 kg wheat = Rs. 22 per kg

Selling price of 20 kg wheat = Rs. 21 per kg

Selling price of 40 kg rice = Rs. 95 per kg

Selling price of 60 kg rice = Rs. 93 per kg

**Concept: **

Total profit = Total selling price - Total cost price.

**Solution:**

Total cost price of wheat = 20 kg × Rs. 20/kg + 80 kg × Rs. 20/kg = Rs. 2000
